skills.name: Astral Meteor
skills.description: Novaria summons an <font color='#404495'>(Astral Sphere)</font> at the target location, continuously dealing 75<font color='#27C0C7'>( +25% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to nearby enemies. After 2s, the sphere will explode, dealing <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> equal to 260<font color='#27C0C7'>( +50% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 4% of the enemy's Max HP to nearby enemies, and increasing <font color='#404495'>(Astral Sphere's)</font> slow effect to 2.5 times the original slow effect.
skills.tips: Use this skill to clear the lane and slow down the enemies, so that you can hit them with your Second Skill more easily.

skills.name: Astral Recall
skills.description:
Novaria summons an <font color='#404495'>(Astral Sphere)</font> at a distance and draws it towards her. At the same time, Novaria gains 20% Movement Speed and can pass through terrain. Passing through a wall will increase the Movement Speed bonus to 60%.
When the <font color='#404495'>(Astral Sphere)</font> reaches Novaria, she can cast <font color='#404495'>(Star Shatter)</font> to launch it in a target direction within 5s. The sphere will explode when hitting an enemy hero, dealing <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> equal to 230<font color='#27C0C7'>( +45% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 4% of the target's Max HP. The damage will increase based on the <font color='#404495'>(Astral Sphere's)</font> travel distance (starting from when the sphere is summoned), up to 2.5 times the original damage.
skills.tips: Use the terrain-ignoring advantage to maximize the damage of Second Skill. It can also be used as an escape ability.

skills.name: Astral Echo
skills.description: Novaria scatters <font color='#404495'>(Astral Echo)</font> in the target direction, briefly slowing enemy heroes hit by 50% while applying <font color='#404495'>(Astral Ring)</font> on them, increasing their hitbox by 2.5 times and revealing their surrounding area. This effect lasts 8s.
skills.tips: An ultra-long-range skill that can provide the vision needed for her Second Skill to hit the enemy.

skills.name: Star Trail
skills.description: <font color='#404495'>(Astral Spheres)</font> summoned by Novaria will continuously slow nearby enemies by 20% and grant vision of them.
skills.tips: Helps Novaria grasp the movement of enemy heroes so that she can hit them with [Star Shatter] more easily.

items.name: Clock of Destiny
items.des: Unique Passive - Time: Gains 20 extra Max HP and 4 extra Magic Power every 20s, capped at 15 stacks.

items.name: Lightning Truncheon
items.des: Unique Passive - Resonate: Every 6s, the next skill that deals damage will resonate, dealing Magic Damage equal to 120% Magic Power against up to 3 enemies and increasing Movement Speed by 30% that decays over 2s.

items.name: Genius Wand
items.des: Unique Passive - Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 3-7 (scales with level) for 2s. Stacks up to 3 times.

items.name: Divine Glaive
items.des: Unique Passive - Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.

items.name: Blood Wings
items.des: Unique Passive - Guard: Gains a shield equal to 200% of Magic Power. The shield will regenerate 20s after being damaged, and grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts.
